description: When are the next US corporate profits figures out? Returns the next scheduled release from the US Bureau of Economic Analysis calendar that includes national corporate profits, with the quarter it covers, the GDP estimate it is bundled with, and the time in Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default). For equity strategists and economists tracking aggregate US profits. It gives the schedule only, not the profit figures or company earnings dates. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_corporate_profits_release
